note: Candidate agent-facing domain overlay packs (B20 DomainOverlay / B03 SkillEligibility). Each pack declares a positive applicability predicate, prohibited contexts and a typed unsupported-capability response. Prose is the agent-facing text an in-project pack would load; it is measured, not executed.

overlays.title: Performance baseline overlay
overlays.prose:
### Performance baseline overlay
Applies only when the project ships a `perf_baseline` workload (benchmark script or production trace) and the task concerns a user-visible latency or throughput change.
- Compare the change against the committed baseline workload, not a microbenchmark.
- Report the workload identifier, the pinned command, and both distributions.
- If no matching baseline exists, record `perf_baseline` as absent and stop; do not invent a synthetic workload.

overlays.title: UI feedback overlay
overlays.prose:
### UI feedback overlay
Applies only when the project declares a `web_ui` capability and the change alters a rendered surface.
- Observe the rendered state before and after; assert the visible outcome, not the internal setter.
- Keep color and contrast rules project-local; pstack ships no universal theme tokens.
- When the project has no UI, this overlay stays inactive.

overlays.title: Browser evidence overlay
overlays.prose:
### Browser evidence overlay
Applies only when a `browser_driver` exists in the project (Playwright/Cypress/CDP or an equivalent harness) and the task asks for demo evidence.
- Capture the interaction and the resulting state; a recording GIF is evidence, not a substitute for an assertion.
- Without a driver, record `browser_driver` as absent and return `BLOCKED`; never fabricate a recording.
- Credentialed flows stay inactive unless the project grants them explicitly.

overlays.title: Bilingual docs overlay
overlays.prose:
### Bilingual docs overlay
Applies only when the project maintains more than one locale (`i18n`) and the change touches user-facing documentation.
- Keep every locale in step; a translated page that lags the source is a defect, not a partial success.
- Do not pair locales for a project that ships a single language.
- Term and glossary choices stay project-owned; pstack ships no universal term triplets.

overlays.title: Upgrade guide overlay
overlays.prose:
### Upgrade guide overlay
Applies only when the project publishes versioned artifacts (`release_tags`) and the change alters a public contract.
- Write the migration from the previous supported version, naming removed and renamed surfaces.
- Link the exact release note; never promise a version that is not tagged.
- Internal-only changes on an unversioned project stay inactive.

overlays.title: Archival notes overlay
overlays.prose:
### Archival notes overlay
Applies only when the project keeps `archival_records` (superseded designs, retired endpoints) that a reader must still be able to follow.
- State what was retired, when, and what replaced it; link the durable record.
- Never archive a surface that is still current.

overlays.title: Stacked-PR overlay
overlays.prose:
### Stacked-PR overlay
Applies only when the forge exposes a supported `forge_stack_api`.
- Use the forge's own stack command and record the CLI plus version.
- On a forge without that feature, land the chain with the supported branch/PR path and record the limitation; never emit a stack command the host cannot answer.

overlays.title: DSH theme tokens overlay (project-owned pack)
overlays.prose:
### DSH theme tokens overlay (project-owned pack)
Applies only when the project declares `dsh_theme_tokens`; it is never a common pstack requirement.
- Read the project's token table before styling; do not assume DSH names.
- Absent the capability, this pack MUST stay unloaded.
